comments.author: Simon
comments.text:
Hi Diana, For the equipment and invention questions, why not use "television" or "phones".

For the magazine question, maybe you could choose a magazine about a sport or hobby that you do - then you can talk more about the activity too.

Choose a game that you played when you were a child - if you explain it well, a description of any game could get a high score.

Hope this helps

...

Thanks Yanwei
